topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; sanctions statement (POL-01 4.8); annual acknowledgment of POL-05 by employees and contractors, including measurement and control room staff
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (96%); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee, chaired by the independent director, receives quarterly cyber risk and POA&M reports
gap: Quarterly reporting with OT metrics formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report, including SOC 2 readiness status, through the observation period

control_description: Security Manager, OT Security Engineer, and system owners designated; IT and OT RACI in POL-01 section 3
Background checks with enhanced checks for Production Controllers and administrators; operator qualification for pipeline tasks; role-based OT training
evidence: Background check records (25 of 25); OQ records (15 of 15); training records
gap: No annual OT security refresher; integrator staff not trained on company rules (P03 PR.AT-02)
remediation: Annual OT refresher and a vendor rules briefing before access (STD-10)

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and policies; performance against POA&M milestones reviewed quarterly by the COO
Information for controls comes from the SIEM, OT sensors, CAB records, and the measurement data service
evidence: SIEM source list; OT sensor coverage; CAB tickets
gap: Flow computer configuration changes and BCC SCADA logs are not captured (P07 AU-02, SI-07)
remediation: Nightly flow computer configuration capture (POAM-007); SCADA logs to the SIEM (POAM-015)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies, standards, and the system description communicated to staff in scope; OCC postings for reporting unexplained HMI behavior (POL-03 4.2)
evidence: Intranet policy page; OCC postings; acknowledgment report

control_description: Shipper portal notices and statements; contact points for shippers in the gathering agreements
gap: Gathering agreements have no security commitments or incident notice terms; no written system description shared with shippers (gap 8)
remediation: Data handling and incident notice amendment to the 5 agreements; publish the system description and service commitments (POAM-021)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives for gathering and measurement (safe operation, accurate measurement, timely statements) stated in the business plan and the BIA
evidence: 2026 business plan; P05 BP-04 and BP-05

control_description: Annual enterprise risk assessment with SP 800-30 Rev. 1 and SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (P01); shipper services view in P01 section 5
evidence: P01 risk register (52 risks) and report

control_description: Measurement theft and ticket falsification considered (P01 R-025); payment fraud training and call-back verification
evidence: P01 R-025; fraud training roster; call-back log

control_description: Change triggers for risk reassessment in POL-01 4.3 (acquisitions, gathering expansions, new vendor connections)
gap: The 2026 compression station additions and packager gateways were installed without a security review
remediation: Apply the POL-01 4.9 vendor connection review and the CAB to all field additions

control_description: Annual independent control assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); monthly security metrics
evidence: P07 plan and results; monthly metrics

control_description: POA&M tracked and reported quarterly to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the P01 risks and the P03 benchmark; SSP control set (P02)
Technology general controls defined for corporate, cloud, and OCC SCADA systems
gap: OT standards for change control, remote access, and backups are drafts (STD-02, STD-04, STD-07)
remediation: Issue the OT standards per the P06 schedule

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-16; standards index with owners
gap: 5 standards are drafts; field procedures for SCADA local accounts are due 2026-12-31
remediation: Issue standards and procedures; record acknowledgments

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures
control_description: Identity provider with MFA for corporate, cloud, jump host, and shipper portal users; OT DMZ at the OCC; encryption of measurement data at rest
evidence: IdP configuration; P04 control map; P07 IA-2(1) (satisfied)
gap: BCC HMIs (which can run the gathering system) use a shared engineering account
remediation: Named HMI accounts at the BCC (POAM-001)

control_description: Accounts provisioned from the HR feed; shipper portal guests invited by the Measurement Supervisor
gap: 4 of 25 sampled leavers kept SCADA local accounts (P07 AC-02f.[04])
remediation: Termination checklist for OT accounts (POAM-001)

topic_label: Role-based access, least privilege, and segregation of duties
control_description: Role-based access in the identity provider, SCADA software, measurement data service, and shipper portal (row-level by shipper)
gap: One portal administrator; no access review with shippers; SCADA accounts reviewed only annually
remediation: Second administrator; quarterly reviews with each shipper; quarterly SCADA reviews (POAM-021, POAM-001)

control_description: Badge access to the OCC, BCC, and server rooms; fenced and locked Central Facility and pump station with cameras
evidence: Badge reports; visitor logs (20 of 20); P07 PE-3
gap: Gate combinations shared by text and changed yearly (P07 PE-03g.[01])
remediation: Quarterly combination changes and app-based distribution (POAM-018)

control_description: Certified destruction of corporate media
gap: Retired flow computers, RTUs, and HMIs are scrapped without wiping configurations and passwords (P01 R-047)
remediation: OT device wipe procedure under POL-04 4.5

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: OT DMZ at the OCC; cloud firewall and web front door for the shipper portal
gap: The BCC reaches the OCC around the OT DMZ; the flow computer vendor's modem at the Central Facility bypasses the jump host (P07 SC-07, AC-17)
remediation: Remove the modem (POAM-002); OT DMZ at the BCC (POAM-003)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS or IPsec for the historian push, measurement data, the shipper portal, and the volume integration service
gap: Shipper statements are sometimes emailed as attachments when the portal is down
remediation: Approved secure transfer service for fallback statements (POL-04 4.2)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on corporate endpoints and servers; application allowlisting on OCC HMIs and SCADA servers

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly authenticated scans of corporate and cloud systems; passive OT vulnerability detection at the OCC and the Central Facility
gap: Flow computer configuration changes not detected; OT advisories matched manually (P07 RA-05, SI-07)
remediation: Nightly configuration capture (POAM-007); monthly advisory matching (POAM-011)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 MDR on IT; OT sensors at the OCC and the Central Facility
gap: OT sensor alerts are reviewed in business hours only; 37 of 112 July alerts waited until the next business day
remediation: Add OT alerts to the MDR contract (POAM-009); interim after-hours call to the OT Security Engineer by the OCC shift lead

control_description: MDR triage within 30 minutes for high severity; incidents logged in the security queue
gap: Field incidents handled locally without tickets in 2 of 10 samples (P07 IR-04d.)
remediation: Single intake through the OCC shift lead (POL-03 4.2)

control_description: Incident response plan with two runbooks and a notification matrix (P08), approved 2026-09-16
gap: Runbooks untested; shipper incident notice not in contracts
remediation: Tabletops by 2026-12-15 (POAM-016); gathering agreement amendments (POAM-021)

control_description: Recovery order in the BIA and runbooks; cloud workloads restore-tested quarterly
gap: No SCADA server restore from the offline image has been tested; the images sit at the BCC (P07 CP-04, CP-09, CP-10)
remediation: Second offline image set and first image restore test (POAM-004)

topic_label: Change authorization, design, testing, and implementation
control_description: CAB for SCADA server and HMI changes; code review for shipper portal releases
gap: Pump station setpoint and flow computer configuration changes are made by work order without a second reviewer or change record (P07 CM-03)
remediation: STD-02; pump station setpoint and flow computer change control (POAM-008, POAM-007)

control_description: Manual operations, line riders, and storage buffers for gathering disruptions (P05 BP-04); cyber insurance
gap: BCC failover untested; contingency plan not updated for the gathering system's OT changes
remediation: Approve the OT recovery procedures and run the first failover test (POAM-005)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Annual SOC 2 reviews for 4 SaaS vendors; new vendor review since 2025 (Part B)
gap: The flow computer vendor, the SCADA integrator, and the compressor packager have never been assessed; 64 vendors not tiered (P07 SA-09, SR-06)
remediation: Tier vendors and assess the 3 OT vendors (POAM-012)

control_description: Capacity of the pump station, LACT units, and the measurement data service monitored; cloud services scale automatically

topic_label: Environmental protections, backup, and recovery infrastructure
control_description: Generators and UPS at the OCC, BCC, pump station, and Central Facility tested monthly; immutable cloud backups
evidence: Generator test logs; backup reports (31 of 31 days)
gap: Offline SCADA images are kept where the corporate network can reach them (P07 CP-09d.[03])
remediation: Headquarters offline image set (POAM-004)

control_description: Historian restored from the offline image (2025); quarterly cloud restores since 2026 Q1
gap: No full BCC failover test since the partial 2023 test; no SCADA image restore
remediation: Image restore test by 2027-01-31 (POAM-004); full failover test by 2027-04-30 and twice a year after (POAM-005)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Shipper volumes and quality classified Confidential (POL-04); row-level portal access by shipper (POL-04 4.8)
gap: Confidentiality commitments to shippers are not in the gathering agreements; one administrator can see and change all shipper access
remediation: Agreement amendments and second administrator (POAM-021)

control_description: Disposal rules in POL-04 4.5
gap: No retention schedule for shipper data; retired flow computers not wiped
remediation: Shipper data retention schedule; OT device wipe procedure

control_description: Measurement objectives (monthly meter proving, daily statement timing) set by the Measurement Supervisor
gap: Processing objectives and specifications for shipper statements are not written into the system description
remediation: Document processing specifications and service commitments in the system description

control_description: Monthly meter proving; flow computer polling; input validation in the field data capture app and volume integration service (SI-10)
gap: Flow computer configuration (meter factors, parameters) changes are not logged or reviewed (P01 R-007)
remediation: Nightly capture and second-person review (POAM-007)

control_description: Measurement data service processes LACT tickets with ticket hashing; monthly reconciliation at invoicing
gap: No daily reconciliation of processed volumes to LACT tickets before statements are produced (P01 R-051)
remediation: Daily automated reconciliation (POAM-021)

control_description: Daily volume statements published on the shipper portal
gap: Statements are published without a reconciliation check, and one administrator controls publishing; errors are found only at monthly invoicing
remediation: Reconcile before publishing and require a second person for corrections (POAM-021)

control_description: LACT tickets and proving records stored with hashes in the measurement data service; daily backups with write-once retention; flow computers keep their own audit records
